checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: bring newly attached N1-Engine to a green aikit check (deps, test command, hygiene, structure, README cold-start)

impact_assessment.why: attach registered the project but its Phase 4 gates fail: zero tests discovered, 4 open() without encoding, a stub __init__, a junk-drawer gui/utils module, and README cold-start drift
impact_assessment.benefits: the project becomes a fully governed AIKit project: real test gate, portable IO, honest structure, cold-start-ready README
impact_assessment.risks: contract: renaming main/gui/utils.py changes its import path; dependency: installing sqlalchemy, networkx, PyQt6 (declared in requirements.txt) into the host Python; concurrency: none, single-user local app; state: test_command edit in .aikit/project.json
impact_assessment.mitigation: rename stays mechanical with every call site updated and the suite re-run; only requirements.txt deps are installed; project.json edited atomically; each milestone checkpointed in the ledger

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Installed declared deps (sqlalchemy 2.1.6, networkx, PyQt6) and set test_command to 'python -m pytest tests'; 13/13 tests pass

[3/5] Fixed 4 open() calls with encoding='utf-8' (reporting.py, settings_manager.py x2, gui/analysis.py), removed AnalysisEngine's empty __init__ stub, renamed main/gui/utils.py to main/gui/dialogs.py with all 7 import sites updated; 13/13 tests pass

[4/5] Added README cold-start quick reference (prerequisites, canonical gate, AIKit commands) and replaced the informal directory block with a compliant What's Inside tree; codebase map regenerated for the dialogs.py rename
[5/5] Verification: aikit check N1-Engine passes 4/4 gates (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); 13/13 tests pass; ADR-001/002 recorded; checklists: passed
[delivery] Publish N1-Engine's integrated state to github.com/Aegean-E/N1-Engine: working tree grafted onto origin/main, explicit staging, checklists: passed
